headline: President Bush created an advisory commission on improving education for Hispanic Americans.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a presidential advisory commission focused on educational excellence for Hispanic Americans. Based on the title, the commission's role was to advise the President on education issues affecting Hispanic students. No summary was provided, so details about its members, duties, and duration are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: The commission was set up to advise the President on education issues that affect them.
